customMethods.script:
userId = self.view.custom.security.userId

		return

			system.perspective.print('No exportInfo')
			return
		
		exportInfo = system.util.jsonDecode(str(system.util.jsonEncode(exportInfo)))

			system.perspective.print('No assets')
			return
		
		message = kanoaApp.custom.ops.asset.copyOrImportAsset(int(userId), exportInfo=exportInfo, overwrite=overwrite)
	else:
		message = kanoaApp.custom.ops.asset.copyOrImportAsset(int(userId), assetId=assetId, newAssetName=newAssetName, overwrite=overwrite)
	
	system.perspective.print("copyOrImportAsset returned %s"%message)
			
	system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast' if message['passed'] else 'showFailerToast', message['message'])
	
	return

messageHandlers.script:
system.perspective.print('assetImportUpdate message rcvd with %s'%payload)
	
	mode = payload['mode']
	assetId = payload['assetId']
	overwrite = payload['overwrite']
	newAssetName = payload['newPath'].split('\\')[-1]
	
	if payload['oldPath'] != payload['newPath']:
		system.perspective.print('Updating assetPath')
		newParts = []
		oldParts = []
		
		newSplit = payload['newPath'].split('\\')
		oldSplit = payload['oldPath'].split('\\')
		
		pathSplitter = '**|**'
		pathBackSlash = '\\\\'
		
		eData = str(system.util.jsonEncode(self.custom.data))
		eData = eData.replace(pathBackSlash, pathSplitter)
		
		for i in range(len(oldSplit)):
			newParts.append(newSplit[i]) 
			oldParts.append(oldSplit[i])
			
			newName = newParts[-1]
			oldName = oldParts[-1]
			
			newPath = pathSplitter.join(newParts[:-1] + [newName])
			oldPath = pathSplitter.join(newParts[:-1] + [oldName])
			
			system.perspective.print("Replacing %s with %s"%(oldPath, newPath))
			eData = eData.replace('"assetPath":"%s'%oldPath, '"assetPath":"%s'%newPath)			
			
			if oldName != newName:
				system.perspective.print("Replacing %s with %s"%(oldName, newName))
				eData = eData.replace('"assetName":"%s"'%oldName, '"assetName":"%s"'%newName)
	
		eData = eData.replace(pathSplitter, pathBackSlash)
		
		data = system.util.jsonDecode(eData)
	else:
		data = self.custom.data
	
	self.saveImport(mode, data, assetId, newAssetName, overwrite)
	
	return

getUniqueStepName
customMethods.script:
import re		
	data = self.view.custom.procedureSteps

	if baseName not in data: return baseName	    # If it doesn't exist, return immediately

	match = re.match(r"(.*?)(\d+)$", baseName)     # Extract number from "Step X"

	if match:
		prefix = match.group(1).strip() + " "
		num = int(match.group(2))
	else:         # fallback if no number
		prefix = baseName + " "
		num = 1

	while True:     # increment until unique
		num += 1
		newName = "{}{}".format(prefix, num)
		if newName not in data:
			return newName
